note: Your verdict (8 Oct): "the settings inputs and UI are awful and uninspired. Everything is just a checkbox with some slider beneath it when it's active." An agent audits every layer's controls by kind (grids, categories, time series, lines, points, live, experiments), designs purpose-built ones per kind, and builds them in the lab, keeping what you already liked unless clearly better. Brief: scratchpad/labui/BRIEF.md. Starts once #118's revisions land (same code).
reply:
Built and live at http://127.0.0.1:18091; your review is next. What's new:
- An On now dock at the top: a row per active layer with its colours, the value under the cursor, an opacity scrub (drag, two-finger swipe, arrow keys) and an x.
- Rows with mini legends, hover previews and loading bars.
- Category layers get chips: click to hide a class, option-click to show it alone, each with its share of the view.
- One shared timeline (month and year rows) with the view's median and spread behind it, play, speed and loop.
- Cyclones and quakes: a histogram behind the year control; quakes get a Smallest magnitude filter; Labels pills.
- Swipe compare: two grids, or one at two times.
- Saved views, a copy-link button, search that matches units and classes, and keys: / search, comma and period for the month, < > for the year, k to play.
- Weather warnings (live) is removed.
Try it: ?labregion=cat&lab=normals-tmax, then drag the Month row and press Compare. Screenshots: scratchpad/labui/shots/ (before/ and after/). Commits f6b5e34..aaa0c9c on lab/global.
text: Generalized lab: a pass over every control, more interesting, usable, intuitive and powerful; remove Weather warnings (live)
